requirements.title: Manuscript Visual Placeholders
requirements.definition: Insert usable visual placeholders into the manuscript chapters covered by each project round.
requirements.boundary_note: Placeholder insertion is a distinct manuscript deliverable that can be completed or assessed independently from tracker maintenance and strategic recommendations.

requirements.title: Chapter Image Tracker Updates
requirements.definition: Update the image tracker for the chapters included in each project round.
requirements.boundary_note: Tracker maintenance is a separate artifact obligation and should not be merged with manuscript placeholder insertion or the explanatory strategy deliverable.

requirements.title: Chapter Visual Strategy Recommendations
requirements.definition: Provide chapter-level visual strategy decisions and high-level reasoning covering which visuals to keep, cut, move, add, source, obtain permission for, or create later.
requirements.boundary_note: Selection, placement, permission, sourcing, creation recommendations, and their high-level rationale are tightly coupled dimensions of one advisory mechanism. Final design, formatting, image sourcing, and graphic creation are excluded rather than treated as separate deliverables.

unresolved_candidates.description: The sample review mentions caption guidance, but the client does not clearly include caption recommendations among the subsequent contracted deliverables.
